author_room.name: Layer E Author Room

agents.claim: A gallery that repeatedly records Aachu but omits Zuv initially mistakes visibility for authorship.
agents.objection: A sequence of attractive solo photographs would reduce the concept to greeting-card sentiment.
agents.recommendation: Open each cropped memory into a complete physical scene where Zuv's action changes what Aachu can do, feel, make, or choose.

agents.claim: The storybook gallery portal makes the thesis visual and gives each line a causal scene.
agents.objection: Phone UI, scrapbooks, shadows, and planted clues would make the reveal mechanical.
agents.recommendation: Keep the phone small and physical; let expanded memories reveal shared movement, creative labour, ordinary relief, and freedom.

author_room.summary: The locked route passes because the gallery is only the inciting discovery; the complete illustrated memories prove the invisible partner's authorship through visible consequences.
inputs_used: creator fact: Zuv came with Aachu when she chose to change cities
creator fact: Zuv kept pushing her to work, took her out to smile, and took random photographs
debate_records: Reject unrelated milestone montage and exceptional institutional scenarios.
Use a gallery-to-complete-memory transition rather than enlarged phone UI.
Make every memory contain a visible two-person exchange or consequence.

exploration_routes.name: Storybook Gallery Portal
exploration_routes.story_lens: A gallery shows who was visible; the expanded memories reveal who made the life around those images possible.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Many couples discover that the person missing from the gallery is the person who kept noticing, encouraging, accompanying, and making room for the other.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The archive repeatedly centres one partner and erases the labour, joy, and freedom created by the other.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu changes cities, creates publicly, laughs after difficult days, and takes opportunities without shrinking.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv moves with her, works behind the creative frame, creates ordinary relief, photographs her unguarded joy, and releases rather than restricts her.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: A tapped gallery image expands into a new-city doorway, creative studio, roadside laugh, and departure threshold; each scene contains observable action and changed state.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: What looked like Zuv's absence becomes evidence that he occupied the unseen position making the memory possible.
exploration_routes.payoff: Aachu deliberately places him inside the next photograph.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Viewers can send it to the partner who rarely appears in their gallery but shaped the life inside it.

stage_scene_gate.action: Aachu and Zuv browse a gallery; a selected image expands into four complete memory scenes; she finally pulls him into a timed photograph.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Her stopped scroll becomes recognition; his unseen or background action changes the environment and her next choice.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Aachu's gaze repeatedly travels toward Zuv rather than the recording device.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: She taps the image, turns the new-city key, creates under his camera-light support, leaves work inside the car, releases from his hand at departure, and pulls him into the final frame.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The stopped scroll, doorway pause, roadside breath, and released hand carry meaning without explanatory poses.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: Each scene visibly could not remain the same without both partners' actions.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The gallery's apparent absence becomes invisible authorship, then the missing partner is returned to the visual record.

rejected_routes.name: Decorative Clue Scavenger Hunt
rejected_routes.story_lens: A shadow, handwriting sample, bag, or hand is planted inside each image.
rejected_routes.reader_mirror: The viewer searches for clues rather than feeling a relationship.
rejected_routes.emotional_obstacle: The visual system becomes clever but emotionally thin.

selected_story_lens: A gallery records one face while the complete memories reveal two people's authorship.
emotional_machine: visible absence -> complete memory evidence -> invisible authorship recognized -> missing partner returned to the frame
proof_engine: Gallery-to-memory expansions reveal moving cities together, shared creative labour, ordinary relief, and love that protects freedom.
reader_mirror: The person who takes, enables, or emotionally creates the photographs is often missing from the gallery.
distribution_reason: A viewer can send this directly to the partner who made their memories possible while rarely appearing inside them.

human_story_setup.emotional_obstacle: The visual archive gives one person visibility and the other person no authorship.
human_story_setup.aachu_role: She discovers the imbalance, relives the moments, and repairs the record.
human_story_setup.zuv_role: He visibly accompanies, encourages, collaborates, creates relief, and protects her freedom.
human_story_setup.proof_engine: Physical actions change doors, light, laughter, departure, and the final photograph.
human_story_setup.earned_payoff: She pulls the absent maker into the next memory.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer recognizes their own missing photographer/supporter and sends the carousel to them.
success_definition.creative_success: Every expanded memory reads as a two-person scene with action, reaction, and consequence before copy.
success_definition.brand_success: The route feels like an illustrated A Story of Two storybook rather than stock photography or phone UI.
success_definition.production_success: Seven separate native 1080x1440 illustrated frames preserve identity, exact text, brandmark, and visual continuity.

stage_scene_gate.action: The gallery discovery opens four complete memory scenes and returns to a repaired final photograph.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Aachu's gaze and choices respond directly to Zuv's presence and action.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention progresses from the phone to Zuv across the montage.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Phone tap, key turn, light adjustment, spontaneous photograph, released backpack strap, and final pull into frame.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: Stopped scrolling and the released departure hand create visible pauses.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: A new home opens, creative work becomes visible, laughter interrupts a difficult day, opportunity remains open, and the archive is repaired.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The missing person is revealed as a co-author of every memory.

process_influences.title: Proof Before Poetry
process_influences.reason: The final poetic line is earned only after the complete memories reveal causal actions.

process_influences.title: Misread To Tender Truth
process_influences.reason: The gallery's visual omission is reinterpreted as the position from which Zuv helped create the memories.
